items.title: Activist Monk But Buntenh Released on Bail From US Immigration Detention
items.summary: Cambodian activist monk But Buntenh was released on bail Tuesday from a U.S. immigration detention center, more than a week after he was detained for allegedly overstaying his visa, he told diaspora media.
